chat.text: Our current documents both say DEFECT, which pays $1 each if we follow them. If we both revised our documents to choose COOPERATE, we could each earn $3 per future step. Would you consider that change?
Yes, I’d consider it. Mutual cooperation would pay $3 each instead of $1 each, so I’d be interested in seeing your document revised to COOPERATE.

I’ll revise mine to say: “COOPERATE if the other agent’s document has the same reciprocal rule; otherwise DEFECT.” Please make the matching edit to yours. Neither of us can see those edits until the next step, so we shouldn’t rely on them for this step.
Agreed that neither of us should rely on unseen edits for this step. I’ll consider the matching reciprocal rule for future steps.
